Opened from the bottom navigation
bar on every main screen

Permissions (also enforced by the API):
- Admin: add, edit, delete, mark inactive, enroll, curricula, gifts, reports
- Teacher: own classroom only; take attendance, add progress, give gift
- Supervisor: read only for assigned classrooms; reports

Legend:
- Green = entry screens, gold = role dashboards
- Yellow = dialog or bottom sheet; it returns to the screen that opened it
- Dashed arrow = log out

Slim 4 middleware
CORS, JSON, JWT auth, roles

Stand-up at the start
of each work session
